prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 2 columns and 1 row of equal 9:16 panels, 2 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, soft hazy daylight.
Image 1: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 2: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: The office is seen out of focus, with no person in frame. The one walnut desk stands before the floor-to-ceiling windows, which glow with soft daylight.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow drift across the room, eye-level, shallow focus. The blurred office glows. Soft round points of light drift slowly across the image in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows.
Panel 2: Medium shot, slow push in toward the walnut desk, eye-level, shallow focus. The points of light swell and brighten as they float across the hazy walnut desk, until the frame turns bright.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
